decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed was cluttered with accessories like cases and charging cables, but I managed to isolate a strong consideration set covering different price points and use cases. I evaluated the budget-friendly LENRUE and comiso speakers, the mid-range DOSS SoundBox Pro+, and the premium Bang & Olufsen and JBL models. I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because of its exceptional 4.8 rating across over 16,000 reviews, its IP67 waterproof rating, and its 20-hour battery life, which makes it the most reliable all-around choice for a portable Bluetooth speaker.
